guide.flowline.pipes.1: Pipes connect to pipes of the same type and to any block that can hold what they carry.
guide.flowline.pipes.2: A pipe moves nothing by itself: sneak + right-click a side with a wrench to make it Extract. That side takes from its block and gives to the other blocks attached to the network.
guide.flowline.pipes.3: Right-click a side to open its screen, whatever you hold: filters, distribution, redstone and upgrades. Sneak + right-click to place a block against the pipe instead.
guide.flowline.pipes.4: Dye pipes to keep networks apart: two different colours never connect. A pipe in the off hand lays a whole route (Build for me); the mode key, B by default, switches modes.
guide.flowline.universal_pipe.1: Moves items, fluids and energy at once. Each side can switch its channels on and off in its screen.
guide.flowline.universal_pipe.2: With Curvy Pipes installed, the mode key cycles Build for me, Curvy: Items, Curvy: Fluids and Curvy: Energy; a curved line carries the chosen one.
guide.flowline.wrench.1: Sneak + right-click a side: Insert, then Extract, then disconnected, then Insert again.
guide.flowline.wrench.2: Right-click a side: open its screen.
guide.flowline.wrench.3: Sneak + scroll on a side: Extract sides change their distribution (with Ctrl: their redstone mode), Insert sides change their priority (with Ctrl: by 10).
guide.flowline.wrench.4: Wrenches from other mods work on pipes too.
guide.flowline.upgrades.1: Six slots per side. Speed: shorter waits between operations. Stack: more per operation. Filter: more filter rules. Knozy: all three at once.
guide.flowline.upgrades.2: Insert sides only take Filter upgrades.
guide.flowline.filter_card.1: Sneak + right-click a side to copy its filter rules, right-click another side to paste them, sneak + use it in the air to clear it.
guide.flowline.filter_card.2: Only the rules are copied; mode, settings and upgrades stay where they are.
